name: PasswordInput
description: Mortar password field for sign-in, sign-up and reset screens: a show/hide toggle that keeps focus, the right autocomplete for current or new passwords, an optional live requirement checklist and a strength meter.

props.label: string
props.toggleLabel: string (default "Show password"; the toggle's pressed state says whether the password is visible)
props.required: boolean (native; adds a decorative marker to the label)

contract.usage: Import { PasswordInput } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Use it for every password field instead of Input type="password". Sign-in: purpose="current" (the default, autocomplete="current-password"). Sign-up and reset: purpose="new" (autocomplete="new-password"), with every rule the server enforces listed in requirements from the start and marked met as the person types; add strength from a real estimator. Pair it with a username or email field that has autocomplete="username" or "email" in the same form so password managers save both. For a confirm field, use a second PasswordInput purpose="new" and validate the match on submit. See docs/auth-flows.md.
contract.avoid: Do not block paste, hide password rules until a failed submit, or add your own show/hide button. Do not copy implementations or override central colours.
contract.accessibility: The toggle is a button named "Show password" with aria-pressed, controls the field and keeps focus. Requirements are a named list that describes the field, each item ending in "met" or "not met"; a polite status announces only when every requirement becomes met (or stops being met), not on each keystroke. The strength meter is role="meter" with the label as its value text.
